topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
response: MPLS mitigates congestion through traffic engineering and QoS guarantees, while IPsec VPNs rely on prioritization and encryption. MPLS provides better support for real-time QoS with guaranteed bandwidth and low latency.
reference_context: MPLS and IPsec VPNs are used in electric utility backbones for QoS and security, with MPLS offering better scalability and QoS guarantees.
